name: jira-ticket-creator
description: Create a Jira ticket with the team's defaults (type, Inbox status, component, one type label plus a label per affected project, story points on the team's scale for Task/Bug, epic in Parent, story linked as "split to", sprint on request) and a Russian description shaped by the issue type: a Task says what and where and leaves how to the implementer, a Bug follows the standard fixed section set, Story and Research get short forms. Creates the ticket straight away and makes no lookup calls. Tuned for the PX project; requires the Atlassian MCP server.
